waylight.config.title: Waylight
waylight.config.option.lantern_type.desc: Choose which vanilla lantern model Waylight renders on your hip.
waylight.config.option.lantern_side.desc: Choose which hip Waylight anchors the lantern to.
waylight.config.option.first_person_ligh: Keep Waylight's dynamic light active even when the lantern model is hidden in first person.
waylight.config.option.extinguish_underw: Keep the lantern on your hip but temporarily turn its light off while fully submerged.
Scale how much the lantern reacts to movement, turning, jumps, and falls.
waylight.config.option.debug_anchor_gizm: Render a small RGB gizmo at the lantern anchor for transform tuning.
